_about: Engine settings for csv_ingestion. Everything the notebook would otherwise hard-code lives here: Drive API details, parser fallbacks, the metadata column catalogue, writer options and naming rules. Feed-specific settings belong in ingestion_config.json instead - this file rarely changes, that one changes whenever a feed is added.

widgets._note: Defaults only. A job's base_parameters override them.

_python_packages_note: Documented here for reference, but the %pip cell cannot read this file - a magic command runs before any Python does. Keep the two in step by hand if the requirement changes.

drive._mime_note: A native Google Sheet holds no file bytes and must be exported rather than downloaded, hence sheet_export_as.

parser._temporal_note: Types routed through to_date / to_timestamp when a column declares a 'format'. Anything else uses a plain cast.

_metadata_columns_note: Catalogue of available ingestion metadata columns. A feed's destination.metadata_columns picks which of these to add by name. Adding a new kind means adding an entry here plus a matching 'value' producer in the notebook. This is a list rather than a map because every column name begins with an underscore, and keys starting with an underscore are stripped as documentation when config is loaded.

writer._options_note: mergeSchema stays false so a changed source shape fails the run instead of silently widening the table.

table_naming._digit_note: A SQL identifier cannot begin with a digit, so a suffix starting with one is prefixed.

verify_query: SELECT {batch_col}, {file_col}, MIN({time_col}) AS ingested_at, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM {table} GROUP BY {batch_col}, {file_col} ORDER BY ingested_at DESC
_verify_note: Column placeholders are filled from metadata_columns so renaming a metadata column does not break this query.
